title: BREAKING: Francisco Javier Estrello Arrested on Smuggling of Persons Charge
excerpt: Francisco Javier Estrello was arrested October 26, 2026, by the Texas Department of Public Safety on a third-degree felony charge of smuggling of persons, and booked into the Webb County Jail.
content:
BREAKING: Francisco Javier Estrello was arrested on October 26, 2026, at 5:31 a.m. by the Texas Department of Public Safety and booked into the Webb County Jail, according to the Webb County Sheriff's Office booking record.

Estrello is charged with smuggling of persons, a third-degree felony, and evading arrest or detention with a vehicle, a state jail felony. The charges are allegations, and Estrello is presumed innocent until proven guilty.

No bond amounts were listed in the booking record at the time of this report.

Sources: Webb County Sheriff's Office Booking Jail Search; Webb County public-access court records.
